newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Gist-Brocades in cosmetics dispenser JV.
newsitem.headline: Gist-Brocades in cosmetics dispenser JV.

text.p: Dutch biochemicals and food group Gist-Brocades NV said on Monday it had launched a 50-50 joint venture with Dutch firm Airspray International BV for the production of a double-chamber cosmetics dispenser.
"The new joint venture, CosmoCair, combines Gist-Brocades' knowledge in the field of biological active ingredients with Airspray's advanced dispenser technology," Gist said.
The double-chamber dispenser is designed to prolong the life of cosmetics containing active ingredients by storing the ingredients separately and mixing them only when the dispenser is used.
Airspray International, based in Beverwijk north of Amsterdam, specialises in the development, production and marketing of high-tech consumer products dispensers.
